_about: Data for the phone's social engine (/* phonesocial */ in index.html, job phonesocial). Edit freely. Templates: {name} person, {item} item, {n} amount, {ref} who has it, {shop} shop, {until} closing time, {home} where. Moods: good / ok / grumpy. Personas: warm, gruff, shy, biz, mum. Sched: h=[from,to] game hours (wraps past midnight), days='all'|'sun'|'mon-sat', k=sleep|work|church|out|home, at=place. A person's own 'lines' override the persona pool. 'enabled:false' items are listed for later: nothing in the game uses them yet (items must make sense).
